```html
<div class="container mx-auto p-4">
    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold">Dashboard</h1>

    <!-- User Information -->
    <div class="bg-gray-100 rounded shadow p-4 mt-8 mb-4">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold">Welcome, {{ $user->name }}!</h2>
        <p class="mt-2">Email: {{ $user->email }}</p>
        <p class="mt-2">Role: {{ $user->role }}</p>
    </div>

    <!-- Recent Transactions -->
    <div class="bg-gray-100 rounded shadow p-4 mt-8 mb-4">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold">Recent Transactions</h2>
        <table class="w-full border-collapse">
            <thead>
                <tr class="bg-gray-200 text-gray-900 uppercase">
                    <th>Transaction ID</th>
                    <th>Date</th>
                    <th>Amount</th>
                    <th>Status</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
                @foreach ($transactions as $transaction)
                    <tr class="border border-gray-200">
                        <td>{{ $transaction->id }}</td>
                        <td>{{ $transaction->created_at }}</td>
                        <td>${{ $transaction->amount }}</td>
                        <td>{{ $transaction->status }}</td>
                    </tr>
                @endforeach
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>

    <!-- Statistics -->
    <div class="bg-gray-100 rounded shadow p-4 mt-8 mb-4">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold">Statistics</h2>
        <p>Income: ${{ $income }}</p>
        <p>Expenses: ${{ $expenses }}</p>
        <p>Savings: ${{ $savings }}</p>
    </div>

    <!-- Button to Add New Transaction -->
    <button wire:model="showForm" class="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded shadow mt-8">
        Add New Transaction
    </button>

    <!-- Form for Adding New Transaction -->
    @if ($showForm)
        <form wire:submit.prevent="storeTransaction" class="bg-gray-100 rounded shadow p-4 mt-8 mb-4">
            <div>
                <label for="transactionId">Transaction ID</label>
                <input type="text" id="transactionId" wire:model="transaction.id" required class="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded py-2 px-4">
            </div>

            <div>
                <label for="date">Date</label>
                <input type="date" id="date" wire:model="transaction.date" required class="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded py-2 px-4">
            </div>

            <div>
                <label for="amount">Amount</label>
                <input type="number" id="amount" wire:model="transaction.amount" required class="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded py-2 px-4">
            </div>

            <div>
                <label for="status">Status</label>
                <select id="status" wire:model="transaction.status" required class="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded py-2 px-4">
                    <option value="">Select Status</option>
                    <option value="pending">Pending</option>
                    <option value="approved">Approved</option>
                    <option value="rejected">Rejected</option>
                </select>
            </div>

            <button type="submit" class="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded shadow mt-8">
                Add Transaction
            </button>
        </form>
    @endif
</div>
```
